subject: Sunrise Health — multi-app provisioning & term alignment
messages:
From: Jordan Klein <jk@sunrisehealth.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-26T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Expansion: additional apps / keys + term question

Hey Stephanie —

We had a product sync today and Engineering + Product want to spin up two new projects that will call Redwood for assistant and extraction features. Before we schedule any work, can you confirm:

- Can we get separate API keys per project (dev/staging/prod) under our existing account?
- Will adding these projects require a contract amendment or will they fit under our current term/commit?
- Any ETA you can share for provisioning keys and a recommended rollout order (staging -> prod per project, or parallel)?

We’re targeting an internal pilot week of Oct 18, so parity on keys early next week would help if possible.

Thanks,
Jordan Klein
Sr. Product Manager — Sunrise Health
[jk@sunrisehealth.com]

[Attachment: none]

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: Jordan Klein <jk@sunrisehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-27T09:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: additional apps / keys + term question

Jordan — thanks for the signal. Short answers up front: yes on per-project keys; usually no immediate term change unless you want additional committed capacity or a discount adjustment.

Proposal and next steps:
1) I’ll provision three key namespaces per new project (dev/staging/prod) — we can do that within 24 hours once you confirm project slugs.
2) If traffic stays within current committed token baseline, no amendment required. If you expect sustained uplift (>25% month-over-month baseline for >2 months) we recommend either a short addendum or temporary burst capacity.
3) Rollout: staging -> prod for project A, parallel staging for project B while we validate; Marissa (cc’d) will own the activation checklist and telemetry hooks.

Attached is an updated mutual action plan (Sunrise+MAP_v2.pdf) that outlines timing, owners, and approval gates.

Can you send the project names and who should receive the staging keys? Also: do you need temporary dev-only keys with relaxed quotas?

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
[Attachment: Sunrise+MAP_v2.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Jordan Klein <jk@sunrisehealth.com>, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-27T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: additional apps / keys + term question

Looping in the activation checklist and a CSV template for requesting keys — please fill the "API_Key_Request.csv" with project slug, environment, point of contact, and expected monthly token estimate. I’ll use those fields to create namespaced keys and translate to rate limits.

Quick rollout checklist (high level):
- You send filled CSV (project slugs + contact emails)
- We create namespaces & issue staging keys (T+24h)
- App teams smoke test against staging endpoints; enable KV cache for assistants
- When green, we swap to prod keys and note the change in the MAP
- Marissa runs a telemetry snapshot and shares cost delta

Also: if you want temporary higher quotas for the pilot (Oct 18), indicate that in the CSV under "burst_quota" and we can approve a one-week burst without contract changes.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: API_Key_Request.csv (text/csv)]

From: Jordan Klein <jk@sunrisehealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-28T08:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: additional apps / keys + term question

Thanks — I uploaded the CSV and added expected monthly token columns. Project slugs:
- patient-portal-v2
- clinician-assist-batch

We want staging keys for both by Oct 4 to start internal validation; pilot on Oct 18 will use prod keys for patient-portal-v2 only. Clinician-assist-batch will remain in internal pilot through Nov.

Procurement note: Meera in procurement will need to know whether this triggers an amendment. She’s on cc. If we stay within baseline, procurement can skip legal review; otherwise they’ll ask for an addendum.

Also: can we get temporary dev/staging keys with a higher quota for the week of Oct 11-18? I put burst_quota=200k tokens in the CSV for patient-portal-v2.

On Sep 27, 2027, at 09:24, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com wrote:
> Jordan — thanks for the signal. Short answers up front: yes on per-project keys; usually no immediate term change unless you want additional committed capacity or a discount adjustment.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Jordan

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Jordan Klein <jk@sunrisehealth.com>, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-09-29T13:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: additional apps / keys + term question

Jordan / team — quick note from contract ops:
- Adding namespaced API keys and issuing staging/prod credentials does NOT require a full contract amendment if usage remains within the existing committed spend.
- If Sunrise elects to convert the pilot into a sustained uplift and wants to formalize a discount or commit increase, we will draft a one-page addendum (turnaround 2–3 business days once terms agreed).
- DocuSign link for addendum templates (if you need it): https://redwood.docusign.com/prepare/DL-3579-addendum

We can also pre-authorize a one-week burst (as Marissa noted) without modifying the term — we’ll log it to the account and report the delta. If procurement requires a PO for the pilot burst, let us know and we’ll accept a provisional PO.

Laura Bennett
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Jordan Klein <jk@sunrisehealth.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, Meera Patel <meera.patel@sunrisehealth.com>
Date: 2027-09-30T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: additional apps / keys + term question

Perfect — thanks everyone.

I confirmed with Product: we’re good to start with the two projects as listed. Marissa — staging keys for patient-portal-v2 and clinician-assist-batch by Monday (Oct 4) would be ideal. Please enable the 200k token burst for patient-portal-v2 for Oct 11–18.

Procurement: Meera, we don’t need a formal amendment unless usage trends above baseline; please hold off on legal review for now. If we need a PO for the burst week I’ll flag.

Next: schedule kickoff — Stephanie, can you propose 30-min slot this week for a short activation walkthrough?
